answer: Make clone farming self-taxing: every new address posts a slashable deposit into a cold basalt vault, with the required size rising as its first-epoch timing and counterparties resemble an existing cluster. That deposit is the sole anchor for panel seats and vote weight, and unbonding starts only after the last settlement it affected. Influence may climb only a public trellis of delayed work receipts whose counterparties sit outside the dense neighborhood. Copying a successful pattern therefore raises the next copy's price instead of lowering it.
